It has grown used to your hand.
It belongs to you. And it wants something.
Es ist ein Teil von dir geworden, mit ei: It has become part of you, with a will of its own.
Es will kämpfen. Ein Tag ohne Sieg macht: It wants to fight. A day without a victory makes it impatient.
Es will, dass du dich wehrst. Pariere, s: It wants you to fight back. Parry, or it will think you weak.
Es will sehen, was hinter dem Nebel lieg: It wants to see what lies behind the fog. Open your Spirit Sight for it.
Es will Stimmen hören und Geheimnisse sa: It wants to hear voices and gather secrets.
Es will mehr. Mehr Münzen, mehr Dinge, m: It wants more. More coins, more things, more open doors.
Die Bindung wächst. Es ist dir jetzt ver: The bond grows. It is familiar to you now, and its benefits grow stronger.
Es ist jetzt an dich gebunden und noch s: It is now bound to you and stronger still. From now on it wants something from you every game day.
Es ist mit dir verwachsen. Seine Vorteil: It has grown into you. Its benefits work twice as strongly, its curses weigh heavier, and it also wants you to live by your pathway.
Es hat heute nicht bekommen, was es woll: It didn't get what it wanted today and is sullen. Its benefits now only work at half strength.
Es ist zornig. Seine Vorteile ruhen, sei: It is wrathful. Its benefits lie dormant, its curses bite harder.
Es hat sich gegen dich gewandt. Nur noch: It has turned against you. Only its curses still work, twice as strong. Give it what it wants, or part with it.
Es ist besänftigt, sein Groll lässt nach: It is appeased; its grudge eases.
Vorteile nur halb, Flüche stärker, etwas: Benefits at half, curses stronger, some unrest.
Vorteile ruhen, Flüche deutlich stärker,: Benefits dormant, curses much stronger, more unrest.
Nur Flüche, doppelt so stark, viel Unruh: Curses only, twice as strong, a lot of unrest.
Lange getragene Artefakte binden sich an: Artifacts you carry for a long time bond with you: they grow stronger, but from “Bound” on they want something every game day and hold a grudge if they don't get it.
